{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Identify duplicate patient_id entries
duplicate_mask = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_patients = data[duplicate_mask]
num_duplicate_patients = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries (rows): {num_duplicate_patients}")

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Count total number of unique patients (all enrolled patients, including those with QC failures)
num_patients = len(data_dedup)
print(f"Total number of enrolled patients after deduplication: {num_patients}")"}
